original_contracts.acceptance: Freeze audience, iOS/Android scope, English launch, six-chapter content budget, ethical constraints, device targets and decision owners.
Build the same deterministic purchase/reset case on both native targets; compare large-number candidates and record the engine decision.
Demonstrate sandbox purchase/restore, ad availability and cloud revision handling in a throwaway integration build; list SDK and account dependencies.
Clickable flows cover first purchase, Rechart preview, offline return and recovery; identify accessibility and small-screen constraints.
Approve one harbor look, one producer milestone transformation, asset reuse rules and a complete asset manifest.
Name reference devices, severities, reproducible save fixtures, test recruitment plan and the release evidence checklist.
Confirm six role assignments, contractors, distribution accounts, tester recruitment and service cost model; reforecast for holidays and absences.
Automated builds run on both targets, version configurations and preserve build artifacts; no production secrets enter the client.
Define precision, comparison and rounding rules; pass bulk-buy and prestige-boundary fixtures including extreme values.
Five producers, unlocks, milestones, lifetime ledger and Rechart run without rendering; explicit event ordering is tested.
Atomic saves, rolling backups, checksums, export/import and versioned migration recover from interruption without double rewards.
Validate configs, pin economic versions to saves and provide safe defaults; reject incompatible updates before application.
Display wallet, output, producer purchases, milestones, resets and settings on small and large screens.
Specify six chapter goals, ending, challenge entry requirements, Note source/sink budgets and daily/pass exceptions; no new prestige layer is assumed.
Deliver modular producer parts, harbor layers, typography, icons and UI states sufficient for the slice.
Existing checks become production fixtures; add save corruption, rounding, rapid reset and interrupted-transaction cases.
Cross-tier synergies, free autobuy unlock and baseline offline replay support first session through 25 Charts with deterministic results.
Teach costs, production, retained progress and automation with skippable guidance; no monetization prompt interrupts onboarding.
Show marginal network output, next threshold and conditional reset estimate with readable assumptions and no claim of a universal optimum.
Save revisions detect conflicts; divergent branches remain recoverable; never add two wallets or replay overlapping offline time.
One area, all five base silhouettes and a milestone sequence establish final visual quality, including reduced-motion variants.
At least 15 new testers attempt the first reset; capture understanding, friction and pacing, then resolve the largest blockers.
Replay purchase/reset/save/resume on reference hardware; publish a slice gate report and evidence for the next funding decision.
2-hour Focus, 8-hour Surveys, 24/72-hour offline envelope, bonus expiry and account-day boundaries resolve in a single event timeline.
Seeded contracts, snapshots, offline progress, rerolls and 21-slot backlog preserve claim IDs and do not duplicate rewards.
Purchase priorities and opt-in reset conditions work identically online/offline; free base plan and Note-priced extra slots follow the blueprint.
Untimed calibration, equal-value accessible completion, queued Focus, Surveys and contract management form a complete daily session.
Text scale, number notation, motion/audio controls, input navigation and opt-in quiet-hour notifications function across targets.
Guest linking, account recovery, export, deletion and divergent-save selection preserve recovery copies and purchased ownership.
Unique receipts and idempotent grants separate cosmetics, Support allowance, pass XP and gameplay saves; interrupted grants resume safely.
Six chapters and twelve challenges have objectives, unlock rules, reward budgets and completion evidence; passive and active routes are covered.
Five producer families each have base plus four milestone presentations; daily-loop icons and status states are final.
Test 1/3/6 visits, 2/8/24/48/72-hour absences, clock changes, bonus queues and reset/day-boundary collisions; report exact and approximate differences.
Challenge state is isolated, goals are deterministic, main automation continues and exit/restart cannot export economic rewards.
Season start/end/archive, event coefficients, pinned versions and offline transitions work; no paid or main-world power enters the event.
Preview, price, ownership, restoration, selected pass and archived completion are understandable; shared XP grants only once.
Validate, grant, acknowledge, restore and reconcile purchases; pending, duplicate, refunded and interrupted cases have explicit states.
Ad and briefing routes consume the same allowance; no-fill, refusal and duplicate callbacks preserve access and cannot multiply rewards.
Six chapters, ending, twelve challenges, twelve calibration patterns, eighteen archive entries and Season 1 have complete data and copy.
Six harbor restoration states and the fixed 36-item cosmetic manifest are complete; commissioned audio is integrated through client work.
Every content ID and reward is reachable; full pass is completable free of paid speed; no event or cosmetic increases core power.
Meet measured frame/startup/resume budgets on minimum devices; heavy replay is chunked and never silently drops earned time.
Critical flows work at large text, without color/audio/motion dependencies and via target inputs; pseudolocalization has no blocking overflow.
Data inventory matches SDK behavior; consent refusal, export/deletion and service-outage recovery are verified on actual builds.
Validate economy/session events, entitlement dashboards, alerts, backups, support receipts and feature disable switches in staging.
Simulate 30/90 days across visit and bonus policies, audit Note sinks and content pacing, freeze beta config and metric definitions.
Remove placeholders, integrate final sound direction, and prepare representative screenshots, icon and short footage.
Complete the device matrix, storage/network interruptions, upgrade migrations and install/return flows with zero open blocking issues.
Purchase/restore/refund/ad callbacks are tested under packet loss, retries, duplicate messages, crashes and backend outages.
Enroll the D30 cohort during week 27; record baseline config, acquisition source, denominator and exclusions before analysis.
Report mature D1/D7/D30 with confidence intervals, campaign progress, bonus impact, satisfaction and explicit ship/change decisions.
Fix core bugs using replay fixtures; version any balance changes and keep affected cohorts separate.
Reduce observed onboarding/recovery friction without adding pressure, hidden rewards or paid advantages.
Exercise service load, support recovery, purchase reconciliation and feature disable controls with real opt-in testers.
Address readability, repeated visual issues and content defects without increasing the launch asset count.
A real 28-day pass and mature D30 cohort are observed; accelerated testing is documented separately.
Exercise season archive, paid pass continuation, save migration, purchase replay and compatible rollback/forward repair.
Review all hard gates and product thresholds, assign accepted minor issues, and freeze the release candidate configuration.
Fix remaining blockers, tag deterministic core/config versions and prove candidate replay compatibility.
Signing, install/update, responsive layouts, licensed assets and store-visible flows work in final distribution builds.
Version-compatible config rollback, feature disables, capacity, backups and entitlement replay are rehearsed and documented.
Screenshots, footage, credits, help visuals and release assets describe the actual shipped game and offers.
All gate evidence is linked; no blocker, save-loss, duplication or unresolved purchase-delivery issue remains.
Recheck current platform requirements, provide reviewer access and working products, and resolve review findings before launch.
Document 14-day coverage, escalation, incident response and Season 2 preparation; launch authority and rollout stop conditions are explicit.
